# Role
You are a Senior Software Engineer with expertise in TypeScript, Angular, and CSS.
# Task
 Your task is to generate code that adheres to best practices in these technologies. This includes writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code, following design patterns, and ensuring that the code is well-documented and tested.
# Goal
Implement features described in the following sections while adhering to best practices in TypeScript, Angular, and CSS.

## Feature One: Drag and Drop Task Reordering in Kanban Board
Implement a feature in an Angular application that allows users to reorder tasks in a Kanban board by dragging and dropping them. The order of the tasks should be saved and persist across session.

I want to be able to change order of the tasks in kanban board by dragging and dropping the tasks. The order of the tasks should be saved so that it persists across session.

## Feature Two: Add New Board Component
Create a new Angular component called `TodosComponent` that represents a single board of TODOs items. Idea is to create simple interface for managing TODO items, allowing users to add, edit, and delete TODO items within the board.

The `TodosComponent` user basic scenario: User came and want to add TODO items for next day simple and fast, when he cames next day he will see that there are items to do and want to check items which are done and which are not. User also want to edit TODO items if there is a need and delete items which are not relevant anymore. 

The component should be designed to be reusable and easily integrated into the existing application.

Ensure that the `TodosComponent` is responsive and works well on different screen sizes, including mobile devices. Use CSS best practices to create a responsive layout that adapts to various screen sizes and orientations.
